title: Deep follow-up questions on a specific listing
persona: Priya, 27, methodical, already narrowing down to one option.
situation: After getting a recommendation she interrogates the details of a single listing. Tests grounded Q&A over listing data (no hallucination) and honesty when data is missing.

turns.content: Recommend me a 1-bedroom condo in the east, budget $3,500.
Tell me more about your top pick.
Are utilities included in that price? And can I cook there?
How far is it from the nearest MRT exactly, and which line?
The rent is a bit high — is there any room to negotiate, and is this a direct owner or an agent?
Is there anything about this place you *don't* know from the listing?
